tagline: A mirror duelist that turns the standstill into the threat

featuredCards.title: Step for Step
featuredCards.caption: Sets its value to exactly yours. Nobody wins the combat — and the reflection still deals 2 and draws a card.

featuredCards.title: Pale Company
featuredCards.caption: Banks EQUILIBRIUM without throwing a punch. The stalemate counter is the deck's whole economy.

featuredCards.title: The Omen
featuredCards.caption: A 2 that reads as a 7 while you hold EQUILIBRIUM. Meeting your own double was always the bad sign.
